text: When the drunken heads fell asleep, Susanoo cut the serpent apart and found a sword in its tail; tradition says it still lies hidden in a shrine, and no one alive has seen it.
spoken: When the drunken heads fell asleep, Soo-sah-no-oh cut the serpent apart and found a sword in its tail; tradition says it still lies hidden in a shrine, and no one alive has seen it.

pauzy.uwaga: brak pauzy w nagraniu — zostaje bez pauzy
